_comment: Who wrote the words of Lowth's Isaiah (1795, third edition), the second work of the lowth source, as read on archive.org on 2026-11-01.

records.note: Third edition, 1795. Two lines below, the title page names him 'Lord Bishop of London' (OCR 'Londq^'). Wikipedia gives the first edition as 1778; no printing before 1795 was found on archive.org. William Lowth, whose 1714 commentary on the prophets the same archive.org search lists, is a different writer and is never credited here.
